caption: Odilon Redon, The Eye, Like a Strange Balloon, Mounts toward Infinity (1882)
alt: A charcoal lithograph: a huge eye, its gaze turned upward, floats like a hot-air balloon over a flat marsh, carrying beneath it on fine cords a small platform that holds a severed head.
bibliography: Redon, Odilon. The Eye, Like a Strange Balloon, Mounts toward Infinity. 1882, Los Angeles County Museum of Art, Los Angeles.
title: The Eye, Like a Strange Balloon, Mounts toward Infinity
institution: Los Angeles County Museum of Art
